title: Create gameplay entities and links
summary: Place native spawn, trigger, script, and lighting entities and edit their fields.
outcome: Gameplay markers and volumes with meaningful links.

steps.title: Open the catalog
steps.text: Choose Create → Gameplay entities or the Entities inspector tab, expand Create gameplay entity, and search native IW4 entity types.

steps.title: Place a spawn or point
steps.text: Pick a mode-specific spawn such as mp_dm_spawn or mp_tdm_spawn, then choose Place entity and click the map. Set Angles to control facing.

steps.title: Create a volume
steps.text: For brush triggers such as trigger_multiple or trigger_hurt, first select suitable world brushes, then choose the entity type and Place entity. For trigger_radius, place its bottom-center origin and set positive Radius and Height.

sections.title: Connect and inspect

steps.title: Edit fields
steps.text: Select the entity in the Entities tab. Set Name (native targetname), Target (another entity’s targetname), Angles, and any required Spawnflags. Set Damage for trigger_hurt, then Apply gameplay fields.

steps.title: Link selected sources
steps.text: Select the source entities, add the destination last as the active selection, then choose Connect to active. Use Disconnect to clear selected source links.

tips: Vehicle nodes use Name and Target for route links; select a node to preview the route. Speed and lookahead remain native Entity properties.
Script-specific fields can be entered in Entity properties as unique key=value lines; keep classname present.
